styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal gradient #23272F-#3A424D for hero and dark info panels, brushed silver gradient #C9CDD2 for head close-ups, light stone marble #E9E9E7 for feature screens, soft blue #BFD9EC and periwinkle #8B9BC8 for charging and detail sections

styleLock.surfaceSystem: stacked brushed-metal pedestal steps and matte stone/marble surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, white #FFFFFF on dark panels and charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, single light stroke color, consistent rounded rectangular info cards
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright product presentation, consistent scale across the set, every screen composed as a centered complete balanced layout with natural margins
styleLock.lockText: consistent premium men's grooming tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal gradient #23272F, brushed silver grey #C9CDD2, light stone grey #E9E9E7 and one periwinkle blue accent #8B9BC8; cool-neutral directional studio lighting with controlled speculars and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines, white #FFFFFF text on dark panels and charcoal #2D2D2D text on light panels; consistent thin-line circular outline icons and rounded rectangular info cards; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal dark-tech infographic elements; stable upright product scale and centered placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 13 张电动剃须刀爆款详情长图切片提炼；panel-07 为纯装饰空版面已丢弃，panel-10/11 合并为一镜。已剥离源品牌字样、英文角标、二维码/会员角标、模特手部身份与全部原文案（含续航与进须量数字，改由 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 槽位交由使用方填写），信任镜以参数卡与工艺实拍呈现，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
